label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Interpretive: in the tertia via, 'aliquando nihil…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: Si igitur omnia sunt possibilia non esse, aliquando nihil fuit in rebus
interpretation: Reading A of how the step is licensed: 'igitur' draws it from the preceding 'quod possibile est non esse, quandoque non est' alone, read distributively, which is the quantifier shift. On this reading the step is invalid (the fallacy reading).
